purpose: Contract for owner-valid unattended Second Shift work with durable claim/lease semantics, bounded retry behavior, successor reconciliation, all-rungs exhaustion proof and auditable utilization events.

owner_control_binding.branch_head_rule: Every active peer/system owner lane binds valid_for_control_head to the exact live canonical owner branch head.

admission_rules: Owner path must resolve to an active canonical system through the topology selected by CURRENT-AUTHORITY or to an explicitly routed shared-infrastructure owner.
valid_for_control_head must equal the exact live owner branch head at revalidation time.
READY requires a concrete completion delta and stop condition.
A changed owner head invalidates READY/CLAIMED mutation until re-evaluated.
Only one mutation-capable claim may be live per active owner lane.
Completed/superseded objectives leave active_delegations and trigger successor selection while shift time remains.
Human, author, private-data, external-authority and native-platform blockers cannot be bypassed.
A-01 work additionally requires registered exact-subject qualification and current policy admission.
Missing/stale delegation, completed assignment, blocked critical path, transient dependency, unavailable A-01/runner or empty active list never by itself proves no safe work exists.
Transient dependency retry is finite/classified and switches to independent safe work after budget exhaustion.

PROSE is an active child specialist only at SYSTEM_MASTER/BOOK/PROSE; it receives no independent peer/worker lane and all active PROSE Second Shift work routes through BOOK. Historical standalone PROSE lane evidence remains non-dispatchable.
SYSTEM_MASTER product-root governance is not an active peer-worker lane.

checks: read the topology selected by CURRENT-AUTHORITY
verify the lane remains in SECOND-SHIFT-REGISTRY owner_files
fetch the active owner's live canonical control head
read the obligation registry selected by CURRENT-AUTHORITY
verify objective remains open and owned by this active owner or is explicitly routed shared-infrastructure work administered by this owner
verify exact subject/qualifier for A-01 work

completion_rule: On completion/material block, preserve evidence, release/retire the claim/delegation, re-read live owner authority and bind the highest-value dependency-valid successor while shift time remains; stop at a runtime/tool boundary only after leaving READY successor state or a valid exhaustion proof.
retired_lane_rule: Retired peer/standalone lanes are removed from registry owner_files and do not need empty-lane proofs or new telemetry. Their historical files remain provenance only. Active child systems use the current registry coverage route of their parent/administrator lane.
repair_rule: A repair changing subject code creates a new exact SHA and replacement delegation/repair lineage; historical failed or retired-owner subjects never silently change identity.
authority_boundary: Scheduling/execution never grants product, canonical-writer, A-01, human, author, private, blind, native, publication or production authority.
